# Find a team for your projects

In this page we post projects that need talents through collaboration.
The aim of this page is to increase collaboration between people from different
research groups, institutions, universities and countries.

If you have a project, an idea or an inspiration and you need a team to
co-create your wonders into reality, contact us by email and we will post
your project here.

<br>

## **Project in Nextflow**

Contact: _bishwa.ghimire@utu.fi_

Late stage PhD researcher Bishwa Ghimire is looking for someone interested in Nextflow, conda, docker, singularity, Git, CI/DC, unit testing to create a computational pipeline. The project will be a learning process and the co-creator does not need to be an expert in bioinformatics. There is a possibility for shared first authorship or second authorship depending on the contribution to the project. This is a perfect opportunity for a PhD student or an early-career researcher to get co-authorship in a high impact journal!
